newsitem.title: ITALY: Spread the word but quietly, says Italian group.
newsitem.headline: Spread the word but quietly, says Italian group.

text.p: An Italian consumer group said on Monday it had asked the Roman Catholic Church to spread God's message a little less noisily.

The group, Codacons, said it had complained to local and Catholic authorities in the southern coastal town of Salerno that two churches were blasting out Sunday mass through loudspeakers, disturbing residents and passers-by.
The practice should be restricted to when the churches were full and the volume should be "reduced to the minimum", it said.
"We were alerted to the problem by a party of very Catholic Irish tourists," local Codacons chairman Enrico Marchetti told the Italian news agency ANSA.
